integrity: Exact analytical voltage and norm proof supplied; rational checker is independent corroboration, not an infinite proof. Novelty remains subject to external expert literature verification.
scientific_limitations: Canonical real orthogonal weighted cut/cycle projections only; positive common conductance on one perfect matching and unit conductance on other edges; even graph orders at least eight. No nonorthogonal projection-minimum or arbitrary heterogeneous weight claim.
title: Separated cut–cycle thresholds in matching-weighted complete graphs
